title: England Football Failures
description: Penalty shootouts, tournament exits, and heartbreaks — how well do you know England's most painful football moments?

questions.prompt: In which year did England lose a penalty shootout to West Germany in the 1990 World Cup semi-final?
questions.explanation: England lost 4–3 on penalties to West Germany in the 1990 World Cup semi-final in Turin, Italia 90.

questions.prompt: Which England player missed the decisive penalty against Argentina in the 1998 World Cup?
questions.explanation: David Batty's miss meant England were eliminated by Argentina in the last 16 of the 1998 World Cup.

questions.prompt: Gareth Southgate famously missed a penalty in which tournament?
questions.explanation: Southgate missed England's crucial penalty in the Euro 1996 semi-final shootout against Germany at Wembley.

questions.prompt: England were famously knocked out of the 2010 World Cup in the last 16 by which country?
questions.explanation: Germany beat England 4–1 in the Round of 16 at the 2010 World Cup, controversially disallowing a Lampard goal.

questions.prompt: What was the score when England lost to Iceland at Euro 2016?
questions.explanation: England lost 1–2 to Iceland in the Round of 16 at Euro 2016, one of their most embarrassing exits.

questions.prompt: England lost the Euro 2020 final on penalties to which country?
questions.explanation: Italy beat England 3–2 on penalties in the Euro 2020 final at Wembley after a 1–1 draw.

questions.prompt: Which England player received a red card against Argentina at the 1998 World Cup, reducing England to 10 men?
questions.explanation: David Beckham was sent off for a petulant kick at Diego Simeone, leaving England to play most of the match with 10 men.

questions.prompt: England have never won a major international tournament other than which one?
questions.explanation: The 1966 FIFA World Cup on home soil remains England's only major international honour.

questions.prompt: Which goalkeeper saved the decisive penalty for Portugal against England in the Euro 2004 quarter-final?
questions.explanation: Ricardo saved Darius Vassell's penalty and then scored the winning penalty himself to send England out of Euro 2004.

questions.prompt: England were eliminated in the group stage of which World Cup after losing to the USA?
questions.explanation: England lost 1–0 to the USA at the 1950 World Cup in Brazil, considered one of the greatest upsets in football history.

questions.prompt: Which England player missed the crucial penalty in the Euro 2020 final shootout first?
questions.explanation: Bukayo Saka had his penalty saved by Donnarumma, handing Italy the Euro 2020 title. Sancho and Rashford also missed.

questions.prompt: In which year did England fail to qualify for a World Cup, finishing behind Poland on goal difference?
questions.explanation: England failed to qualify for the 1974 World Cup after a 1–1 draw with Poland meant they missed out on goal difference.
